items.statement: Among all people who start the video programme, the mean KOOS-12 summary score will improve by at least 8 points from baseline to three months.
items.rationale: An improvement of this size among all starters, not only completers, would place local outcomes within the range expected from the trials; the data are routine.
items.risks: Missing three-month scores for people who stopped; regression to the mean after a long wait.

items.statement: Completion will be at least 15 percentage points lower among participants without home broadband than among those with it.
items.rationale: A rural service reported 52 versus 76 percent; the local catchment has similar broadband coverage.
items.risks: Few participants without broadband, giving a wide interval.

items.statement: Participants who stop early will describe technology and group dynamics, rather than the exercises, as the reason.
items.rationale: Interview studies point to set-up problems and difficulty asking questions in video groups.
items.risks: People who stopped may decline interviews.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 anchors the quantitative strand, h2 and h3 guide sampling and integration.
